[01]Who we are

We are EDIT Saffron: 11 students at Lo‑Ellen Park who design, program, machine and wire a competition robot for the FIRST Tech Challenge.

One of Lo‑Ellen Robotics’ FTC teams, working out of the school’s EDIT Lab with CAD, 3D printing and CNC machining.

Meet the team

[02]The machine

The machine

  1. A

    Built to move.

    A compact robot designed around the BIOBUZZ game.

  2. B

    Taken apart.

    Shooter, intake, indexer, chassis and drive: five systems that have to work as one.

  3. C

    Drawn in lines.

    Parts start in CAD before they are cut, printed or machined in the EDIT Lab.

  4. D

    Ready to compete.

    Back together, wired and tuned for the field.

[05]The program

Inside Lo‑Ellen Robotics.

Saffron is one of Lo‑Ellen’s FIRST Tech Challenge teams. The program works to expand STEM education and develop skilled trades in Northern Ontario.
